mechanism: Tobramycin is nephrotoxic and can impair renal function, potentially increasing pioglitazone exposure and risk of fluid retention/heart failure; pioglitazone may mask symptoms of infection that tobramycin is treating.
action: Monitor renal function (serum creatinine, eGFR) regularly during concurrent use; assess for signs of heart failure exacerbation and ensure tobramycin dosing is appropriate for renal function.
